verdict.rationale: Signifyd's REST API sits outside the payment flow. Docs say to call Checkout before "your Payment Gateway" (pre-auth) or Sale after "your payment processor" authorizes (post-auth), which implies it is not tied to any one processor's rails. Multi-PSP support is only implied by this generic wording, not stated outright. missing for 10: an explicit list of supported PSPs/gateways or e-commerce platform connectors, documentation of running multiple processors at once, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the product across whatever payment stack I run — multiple PSPs, gateways, and platforms — rather than being locked to one processor's rails

citations.quote: prior to sending the payment authorization to your payment processor use the Checkout API to submit the order and payment details to Signifyd for fraud review
after the order has been authorized by your payment processor use the Sale API to submit the order and transaction details to Signifyd for fraud review
This call should be made _before_ calling your Payment Gateway.
